analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 45.2 remains in neutral territory, up from 39.4 five days ago but not yet confirming oversold exit. MACD histogram improved to -2.7009 but still negative. Five consecutive daily candles form a Higher Low pattern from the 5-day low ($358.51) to the current price ($392.88), signaling recovery. Trading below SMA200 ($395.14) but above SMA5 ($376.82) confirms short-term support. ADX at 23.6 indicates an early stage of trend formation, making direction confirmation premature. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
